liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Fire On The Mountain** (2 reviews): Jerry's solos on Fire on the Mountain reach realms rarely traveled by music; Intense Fire on the Mountain performance caused audience to stop dancing and watch with jaws dropped [35][36]
- **Dancin' In The Streets** (1 review): First set is underrated, with Dancin', Walking Blues, and Let It Grow noted as monsters [31]
- Reviewer calls this the best Scarlet Begonias to Fire on the Mountain of the eighties [29]
- Jerry's playing on Scarlet Begonias is described as articulate, punctual, and precise [33]

## The recordings

- **gd1985-07-01.shotgun.cpb.redo.34164.shnf** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 163 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1985-07-01.152709.akgc422.davis-holbrook.flac2448**: source not stated; 20 songs; 162 min [2]. Said about its sound: Entire show suffers from 1985 PA distortion originating from Phil's pickups in his new bass [2]
- **gd1985-07-01.144156.nak304.guy.pailes.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 21 songs; 158 min [4]
- **gd1985-07-01.144157.nak304.guy.pailes.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 121 min [7]
- **gd85-07-01.composite.torbjorn.17350.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 160 min; rated 4.66/5 by 28 [8]. Said about its sound: Great sound, typical of the shows from the band's most underrated year [37]
- **gd85-07-01.oade-schoeps.sacks.25243.sbeok.flacf**: source not stated; 19 songs; 163 min; rated 4.78/5 by 8 [16]. Said about its sound: Typically good audience recording captures the essential sound of the pavilion with minimal chatter [40]
- **gd85-07-01.oade.sacks.7892.sbefail.shnf**: source not stated; 19 songs; 164 min; rated 4.5/5 by 3 [17]. Said about its sound: Audio sounds nice and distinct from soundboard, offering a different feel [29]
- **gd85-07-01.sbd.paino.8482.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 155 min; rated 4.6/5 by 8 [20]. Said about its sound: First set features crisp, tight, and dominant Jerry playing upon re-listening [38]

## Around the show

- Beautiful day with high audience energy matching the band's performance in the second set [30]
- One nearby audience member has a contagious laugh, though overall chatter is not too much [40]
- Reviewer prefers this second set over Hershey Park, Cuyahoga Falls, Saratoga, and the previous Merriweather show [30]
- Do not mistake this for the previous night; this Scarlet stands out as the highlight [33]
- Though the 6/30 show was tough to beat, this Scarlet to Fire is a landmark performance [34]
- Show did not blow mind like Greeks, River Bend, and Hershey Park, but first set was crisp [38]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1985-07-01.shotgun.cpb.redo.34164.shnf**: taped by Charles Bandrofcheck; transferred by Charles Bandrofcheck; source: unknown shotgun mics > Sony D6 > Maxell MX 90s (MC) [1]. Also: Re-record of shnid=32596 with azimuth adjustment on SD 4050 and Audacity noise reduction [1]

This Source: Master… [2]
- **gd1985-07-01.144156.nak304.guy.pailes.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Mike Guy and Jim Pailes; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Mike Guy & Jim Pailes's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi CM300 mics w/ CP-4 shotgun caps > Sony D5M (Maxell XLIIS-90) [4]. Also: Oade CMC4/MK41 source supplies crowd, noodle patches, and a 6:53 patch in Drums [4]

Also: Oade CMC4/MK41 source provides crowd, noodle patches, and a 6:53 patch in Drums [7]

Beautiful day with high audience energy matching the band's performance in the second set

Re-record of shnid=32596 with azimuth adjustment on SD 4050 and Audacity noise reduction
Entire show suffers from 1985 PA distortion originating from Phil's pickups in his new bass
